pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Complex, irregular dark brown polygons with highly serrated and jagged pixel gradients along the borders. Individual patches display star-like or dendritic extensions with varying spatial area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous interconnected network of light cream negative space. Junction nodes are prominent, typically forming three-way or four-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively wide and consistent throughout the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette representing a short mane along the superior neck and shoulder transition, visible against the sky background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian symbiont (Oxpecker) on the lower right lateral region of the torso/neck transition.
